description: This file defines the class dm_policy_t which encapsulates policy management functionalities such as initialization, encoding/decoding JSON representations, parsing device radio MAC addresses, and copying policies. It also includes method definitions for managing policy data structures used in a Wi-Fi mesh project.

classes.name: dm_policy_t
classes.description: A class representing a device management policy, with methods for initialization, JSON encoding/decoding, parsing MAC addresses, and comparison operations.

methods.name: int init()
methods.description: Initializes the policy structure by setting it to zero.

methods.name: em_policy_t * get_policy()
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to the current policy.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON object to extract policy information and store it in the policy structure.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the policy data into a JSON object with a specified policy ID.

methods.name: operator ==
methods.description: Compares two dm_policy_t objects for equality.

methods.name: operator =
methods.description: Copies policy data from another dm_policy_t object.

methods.name: parse_dev_radio_mac_from_key
methods.description: Parses a device radio MAC address from the provided key string.
